key_insight: Near-equilibrium accuracy did not ensure consistent fatigue behavior: NequIP predicted an intrinsic stacking fault energy about 7 times lower than EAM and substantially more plastic deformation.
engineering_relevance: Interatomic potentials used for fatigue and fracture simulations need validation under driven loading, not just near-equilibrium benchmarks.
method: Compare an EAM potential with the foundational NequIP potential.
Evaluate near-equilibrium properties and fatigue cycling of a nanoscale Griffith-like flaw.
evidence_signal: Both potentials closely matched reference data for many near-equilibrium properties, but their post-loading energy distributions differed most far above thermally accessible energies.
watch_item: Memory-related crashes and silent extrapolation pose practical risks when deploying foundational potentials.
paper_title: Emergent Fatigue Dynamics from Foundational Interatomic Potentials
